stem: Strikes and spares are part of the scoring in which game?
explanation: A strike knocks down all ten pins with the first ball of a frame, and a spare clears the rest with the second. Twelve strikes in a row make a perfect game of 300.

claims.text: Strikes and spares are scoring terms in ten-pin bowling.
Spares are not part of scoring in baseball, darts or curling; baseball has strikes but no spares.
In ten-pin bowling a strike is knocking down all ten pins with the first ball of a frame, and a spare is knocking down the remaining pins with the second ball.
A perfect game in ten-pin bowling is 12 strikes in a row, for a score of 300.
